svg.title: Figure 1 — Relative tracks — synthetic sample — not a measurement
svg.desc: synthetic sample — not a measurement. Three panels place the synthetic reference and sensor tracks side by side, in the stated run order. Each track panel retains its own labelled metre scale.
svg.text: Figure 1 — Relative tracks — synthetic sample — not a measurement

svg.title: Relative track · G-SAMPLE-001 · synthetic sample — not a measurement
svg.desc: Synthetic sample — not a measurement. The solid black line is the reference path; labelled dashed lines distinguish the eight sensor paths in metres east and north of the start point.
svg.text: Synthetic values illustrate the layout; they are not evidence.
